method: Full pinned source read and Git/SHA256 verification; original AST add_entry and size callback executed with synthetic data and fake widgets.
findings: du callback joins all digits in entire stdout, including path. Original control for12KB reports12288 bytes with plain path but124954624 with data2026 path. It assumes1024-byte du units and does not validate exit status; partial output can appear complete.
add_entry strips leading/trailing whitespace, altering valid Unix paths. Original control inserts /tmp/name for input space-/tmp/name-space. Root slash is silently omitted by this view.
known_paths deduplicates literal normalized-by-strip strings only, not aliases, canonical paths, inode identity or overlapping roots. Scanner-level physical-identity guarantees remain separate.
Recent file URI is converted using removeprefix rather than percent decoding; non-file schemes are not filtered here. No real RecentManager behavior claimed.

Cache is directly truncated/written without atomic replacement or fsync. JSON is parsed without shape validation; malformed valid JSON can fail later outside loader exception handler. No cache corruption was induced.
Each initial/add entry can start a du process; no view-level concurrency bound or cancellation is visible. Historical comment asserting speed is not a benchmark.
Chooser installs a new selection-changed handler on each opening without disconnecting it; selected-row style and selected_locations reset independently. GTK consequences need runtime qualification.
Preferred directories are tagged for original ranking; this is not an exclusion from traversal. Shortcut intentionally scans as untagged.

executed_control.scope: Original AST methods, synthetic du output and fake widgets; no scan, subprocess or persistent cache write.

limits: No GUI runtime, persistent cache mutation or current performance measurement.
